5. Peel the outer layer of the carrot using a vegetable peeler to create a smooth, even surface.

7. Gently bend each strip into a curved shape, using your fingers to shape the edges into a concave form.  
8. Secure the curved strips at the base using small, food-safe adhesive dots or toothpicks inserted at the bottom for structural support.  
9. Allow the structure to dry completely at room temperature for at least 12 hours to set the shape.
